newsitem.title: USA: Mobley to sell some assets to U.S.Filter.
newsitem.headline: Mobley to sell some assets to U.S.Filter.

text.p: Mobley Environmental Services Inc said Thursday it had agreed to sell its environmental assets to U.S. Filter Corp and was mulling alternatives for its oilfield services business in East Texas.
Under the pact, Mobley will receive $8.0 million worth of U.S. Filter common stock and an opportunity to earn additional shares based on the performance of the sold assets, Mobley said.

The assets to be sold include Mobley's service terminals, related fleet and equipment, an oil filter recycling facility, and four processing plants that recycle oil-water mixtures, as well as used oil and oil filters, Mobley said.
The assets are expected to generate about $17 million in 1996 revenues, it said.
Completion of deal is subject to negotiation and signing of a definitive agreement, board approval and due diligence.
Mobley is a Texas-based recycling company that specializes in the collection, treatment and recycling of non-hazardous oil-water mixtures and used oil filters.
